newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fuji Bank says no decision yet on stock issue.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Bank says no decision yet on stock issue.

text.p: Fuji Bank Ltd said on Thursday it had not made any decision on a preferred stock issue.
"We are considering (a preferred stock issue), but we have not decided anything on it," a Fuji Bank spokesman said.
The Japanese daily Yomiuri Shimbun reported on Thursday that the bank had decided to issue preferred stock worth about 150 billion yen, possibly as early as November, in order to boost its capital.
The paper said the issue is likely to be made in the Euromarket. -- Tokyo Equities Desk (813-5473-3714)
